source: external CSV week-date candidate evidence, copied into the repository so internal/datefmt and docs/csv-week-date-mapping-2026-10-12.md cite a tracked path. The original capture lives in the review bundle fix/review-evidence-2026-10-12/ and is not part of a normal checkout. The candidate reports one date per case (the last value in its CSV); the per-value expectations used by internal/datefmt come from the pinned Python reference plus the candidate's round-trip rule.
